error_survey_not_ready: The initial survey questions are being prepared. You can still explore the public chart. Please come back once the survey is ready.
site_tagline: Charting the unknown terrain of human personality, together
footer_non_diagnostic: ISOBATH is not a medical diagnosis, ability assessment or aptitude test. Positions shown are statistical positions of observed response patterns.
landing_title_2: You become an observation point measuring the unknown.
landing_lead: ISOBATH does not sort people into predefined types. It observes participants' answers and draws the terrain their distribution forms. Each new participant makes the chart a little more precise.
stage_desc_PRIOR: Your provisional position is based on the question design and has not yet been calibrated with population responses. The surrounding volume shows uncertainty. Responses are reflected in the next daily update; model refitting is attempted every 14 days.
stage_desc_COLLECTING: The first chart estimate has not been published yet. From the daily update after it is, everyone who has completed the initial survey sees their position together with its uncertainty. Nothing is held back by headcount.
stage_desc_CHARTED: The same model and the same procedure are used whether there is one respondent or a million. While observations are few, positions are uncertain, and we show that spread as it is.
signup_prepare_lead: First, provide the research information and review the consent statements. Then register with Google or your email address.
signup_method_lead: Your preliminary information is ready. After authentication, we will save it to the account you choose and take you to the survey. Your birth year, month and gender choice are not sent to Google.
auth_google_return: After authenticating with Google, you will return to this service.
signup_draft_unavailable: Your information could not be saved temporarily. Allow storage in this tab and try again.
registration_recover: To complete registration, review your birth year and month, gender choice and consent. If your earlier information is no longer available, please enter it again.
signup_birth_hint: We do not need the day. During analysis, age is calculated as of the end of the previous month in Japan time.
signup_gender_heading: Which best describes your current gender? (required)
signup_demographics_note: Your birth year, month and gender choice are stored at registration and used only for research statistics if you consent to research. They are not used for your chart position, question selection, advertising or individual evaluation. You can register with “Prefer not to say”.
signup_demographics_invalid: Check your birth year, month and gender choice. A future month is not allowed.
signup_lead: After registering you will answer about 100 questions. You can pause and resume at any time.
signup_sent_body: Open the link in the email sent to {email} to complete registration.
callback_failed: We could not complete your login. Authentication may have been cancelled or the link may no longer be valid. Please try again from the login page.
consent_lead: Before starting, please review and agree to the following.
consent_terms: I agree to the Terms of Use
consent_privacy: I agree to the Privacy Policy
consent_research: I have read the research information and agree to participate in the research
consent_non_diagnostic: I understand ISOBATH is not a medical diagnosis, ability assessment or aptitude test
auth_error_email_not_confirmed: Your email is not confirmed yet. Please open the link in the confirmation email.
auth_error_weak_password: This password is too weak. Please use a longer one.
auth_error_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
auth_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
survey_instruction: How well does this describe your usual self?
survey_keyboard_hint: You can also answer with keys 1-5.
survey_sync_failed: Your answers could not be saved. They are kept on this device.
profile_initial_done: You have completed the initial survey.
profile_near_boundary: Your position is near a region boundary.
profile_low_confidence: This estimate is still uncertain and may change with new surveys.
profile_region_likely: These probabilities include position uncertainty, so the most likely membership can differ from the sea containing your mean position.
settings_delete_body: All your data, including answers, positions and journey, will be deleted. Published charts are not regenerated retroactively; you are excluded from the next revision. This cannot be undone.
error_busy: The survey ship is busy right now. Please try again shortly.
error_writes_disabled: Surveys are temporarily paused. You can still view the chart.
error_network: Could not reach the survey ship. Check your connection and try again.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
status_body: Even when the survey ship (API) is unreachable, this page and the home page stay available. Please try surveying again later.
legal_japanese_only: This document is currently available in Japanese only. The Japanese version is authoritative.
consent_research_note: You can still take the survey and see results without consenting. Your answers, birth year and month, and gender will not be used for research. If you consent, your answers, derived age and gender will be used for research statistics. You can withdraw at any time in Settings.
settings_research_on: You are participating. Your answers are used, pseudonymised, for research and for building the chart.
settings_research_off: You are not participating. Your answers are not used for research or for building the chart.
settings_research_note: Joining allows research use of your answers and, if provided at registration, your derived age and gender. Withdrawing excludes you from future analyses while keeping surveys and results available. Published charts are not rebuilt retroactively.
survey_done_body: Answers are reflected in the chart by the daily update at 1:00 (Japan time). The next update is {time}. Please check back after your next login.
update_never: The chart has not been updated yet. The next update is {time}.
update_schedule: The chart is updated once a day at 1:00 (Japan time).
survey_continuous_done_today: You have finished today's continuous survey. The next one opens after {time}.
survey_continuous_done_today_plain: You have finished today's continuous survey. You can survey again after the next daily update.
survey_nothing_to_ask: There are no questions to ask right now. We will let you know when new ones are added.
profile_continuous_done_today: You have finished today's continuous survey.
journey_lead: How your position on the chart has moved, recorded at each daily update.
journey_empty: No journey yet. After you complete the initial survey, your position is recorded from the next daily update, once a chart estimate is published.
journey_map_label: Your journey on the chart ({count} points)
journey_version_note: Each chart version has its own axes, so only records of the current version ({version}) are connected.
chart_not_ready: The chart estimate has not been published yet.
chart_legend_density: Darker areas gather more observation points. Darkness does not mean better or worse.
chart_legend_you: The brown dot is your position (posterior mean) at the latest daily update.
chart_legend_suppressed: Areas with fewer than {k} people are not shown.
profile_lead: Answer questions and check your position on the chart. Your changes over time are recorded in Journey.
profile_initial_lead: Start with the initial survey of about 100 questions. You can pause and resume at any time.
profile_position_empty: No position yet. After you complete the initial survey, it appears in the next daily update, once a chart estimate is published.
chart_lead: This shared chart is built from participants’ answers. Find your own answers and results on My page.
chart_join_lead: You can answer questions before the chart is ready. Start with about 100 questions and pause or resume at any time. Research participation is optional.
landing_intro: Your answers become a point of observation.
landing_explanation: No fixed personality types. Together, our everyday answers trace the unfamiliar terrain of being human.
landing_survey_note: About 100 questions to begin. Pause and pick up where you left off.
landing_map_disclaimer: Illustrative terrain, not actual observation data.
landing_map_hint: Move across the surface to move the observation point.
landing_map_keyboard: You can also move the point with the arrow keys.
landing_status_unavailable: Visit the public chart for the latest chart status.
landing_story_title: A chart that is never finished.
landing_story_body: More people. A changing chart. A changing you. We keep a record of the changes themselves.
landing_step_1_body: Answer about 100 questions about your everyday self. There are no correct or ideal answers.
landing_step_2_body: The distribution of participants’ answers gradually forms a chart. Where observations are limited, we make that uncertainty visible.
landing_step_3_body: Continue with 10-20 questions. Observations enter the next daily update, where you can see your position and journey together with their uncertainty.
landing_principle: Depth is not a measure of worth.
landing_principle_body: A position on the chart reflects patterns in your answers. It does not measure your abilities or value, or define you as a type.
chart_empty_title: The terrain is still to come.
chart_empty_body: Once the first estimate is published, everyone who has completed the initial survey sees their position from the next daily update. There is no waiting for a headcount. While observations are few, we show how uncertain the position still is.
survey_rest_note: Take your time. Think about your everyday self.
chart_legend_isobath: The isobaths around the dot enclose the most probable areas holding your position with 50%, 80% and 95% probability (solid line: 95%). They are wider with fewer answers and irregular where the estimate is split.
profile_regions_none: The current estimate cannot yet distinguish multiple seas, so membership probabilities are not shown.
profile_inference_joint: This position was estimated jointly with the chart, including your answers.
profile_inference_cut: This position was computed from your answers with the published chart held fixed.
profile_see_isobath: See the spread of your position on the chart
ocean_gesture: Drag to rotate · scroll to zoom
ocean_no_seas: Sea boundaries have not been estimated yet. They will appear when the population model supports them.
ocean_uncertainty_note: The blue volume contains approximately 95% of the position posterior; the darker interior contains 50%. These are uncertainty volumes, distinct from sea boundaries.
ocean_boundary_note: Sea interiors have posterior predictive membership of at least 50% at that location. Surfaces are clipped to the displayed window.
ocean_transition: Your mean position is in a transitional or unclassified area.
ocean_axes_note: X, Y and Z are standardized latent coordinates of one three-dimensional model. Signs do not indicate better or worse. Reference items in D01, D04 and D07 orient the axes; this does not establish that personality is intrinsically three-dimensional.
ocean_intervals_note: Marginal 95% credible intervals for each axis, distinct from the joint 95% volume.
ocean_canvas_fallback: 3D rendering is unavailable. Coordinates and credible intervals remain available as text.
ocean_density_note: Small grey-blue dots represent aggregate cells. Larger dots contain more respondents; cells with fewer than {k} people are hidden.
profile_chart_unavailable: Sea data could not be loaded. Your surveys and position are still available.
error_timeout: The survey ship did not respond in time. Please try again.
error_session_expired: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
error_service_unavailable: The survey ship is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
survey_storage_unavailable: Answers cannot be stored on this device. Keep this page open until they are sent.
